restaurants.name: Windy City Pie
restaurants.blurb: Started as a clandestine SoDo parking-lot handoff: call ahead, text on arrival, trade cash for a deep pan pie. Now a proper Phinney Ridge dining room where your pizza is walked to the table like a bottle of Barolo. The bake is engineered — a buttery biscuit-crumb base, a tomato layer with real acid, and a cheese wall that shatters. It also bakes the sourdough-base Breezy Town pie, Tuesday to Thursday in limited numbers, since that sibling's Beacon Hill room closed.
